lessonTitle: What a Medical Science Liaison actually does

slides.title: The Field-Facing Scientific Expert
bullets: MSLs are Medical Affairs' field-facing scientific experts
They build peer-to-peer relationships with physicians and researchers
They translate clinical evidence into non-promotional dialogue
Value comes from scientific credibility, not from selling

slides.title: What Fills an MSL's Day
bullets: Scientific exchange with KOLs and treating physicians
Insight generation — capturing what experts say
Support for evidence generation — investigators, registries, RWE gaps
Internal support — medical questions, advisory boards, material review

slides.title: Deep Science Meets Field Work
bullets: Most MSLs hold a PharmD, PhD, MD or equivalent degree
The role combines scientific depth with relationship-driven field work
No volume or revenue target, unlike a sales representative
Trained to give balanced answers, including unfavourable data

slides.title: The Territory Is the Office
bullets: An MSL's office is hospitals, academic centers, clinics and virtual rooms
Medical Advisors and Medical Information typically work from a fixed location
That field presence is what makes peer-to-peer trust possible

slides.title: Not a More Scientific Sales Rep
bullets: New MSLs often frame the role as sales with a science degree
That framing gets the role backwards
Being a trustworthy scientific resource comes first
Commercial benefit is a downstream consequence, never the stated goal

takeaway.title: The MSL role is built on scientific credibility, not on selling
bullets: The role rests on four pillars: exchange, insight, evidence support, internal support
Deep scientific training plus field-based relationship work sets MSLs apart
Any commercial benefit follows credibility, it is never the objective itself
